ui_bugs.issue: RevenueBrainPanel was imported (line 94) and menu entry existed (menuSections.js id='revenue-brain', data-testid='revenue-brain-btn'), but NO render block for activeView==='revenue-brain' existed — clicking sidebar item highlighted the menu but rendered an empty white/dark main content area. action_items: REVIEW: Testing agent added missing render block in App.js for activeView==='revenue-brain' → RevenueBrainPanel. Verify the placement (currently right after base-curve). No other changes were made to business logic.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is now ~2620 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. The activeView switch for panels has ~40 branches and is a maintenance hazard; the fact that RevenueBrainPanel could be imported+menu-wired yet silently not render is a symptom. Extract a panel router (map activeView → lazy panel component) to eliminate whole classes of wire-up bugs.

revenue_brain.py generate_lessons deletes ALL lessons then re-inserts on every cycle — fine for now, but loses lesson_id continuity for any subscribing UI that keys off id. Consider upsert by bucket_key.

revenue_brain.py measure_outcomes computes baseline from prior 4 same-weekday-type dates but averages ALL 4 dates including same-dow-type only in name; the loop steps back by 7 days regardless of dow_type match — for a Friday decision it correctly grabs prior 4 Fridays, but the function name/comment 'aynı gün tipi' suggests weekday/weekend bucket average; verify intent (currently: same day-of-week, not same weekday/weekend bucket).

RevenueBrainPanel calls setGoalInput inside load() every render when goal.target_revenue exists — this overwrites user edits if load() runs after user starts typing. Consider only initializing goalInput once.
